outcome: Successful vaginal delivery after previous cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Women with one previous cesarean section and a current singleton term pregnancy requiring labor induction with an unfavorable cervix
finding: AROM alone for labor induction in women with a previous cesarean section is safe and effective, resulting in high VBAC success rates.
mod_finding: Artificial rupture of membranes (AROM) as a single mode of labor induction in women with a previous Cesarean section is a safe and efficient practice with high rates of successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
